<!--
This is the issue tracker for the MarkSync web extension (https://github.com/MarkSyncOrg/app-next).

MarkSync syncs against an xBrowserSync-compatible backend. If your problem is with the
backend/API itself (a self-hosted or third-party service), please report it to that
service's maintainers rather than here.

Before you continue, please check the existing issues to see if yours is already
reported. If the form below is not filled in adequately the issue may be closed without
further consideration.
-->
